verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an official MCP server ('Supermemory MCP') documented in detail — it lets any MCP-compatible assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf) share a memory layer, with natural-language tool selection and space-scoped context, and this is corroborated independently by the creator's HN post noting 60k+ daily users after going viral. missing for 10: independent hands-on reliability/security review of the MCP server itself beyond the creator's own account.
